_note: Cross-file (Lens C) answer key. Both files load into context together, so a project rule that restates a global one is wasted tokens, and a project rule that contradicts a global one is a conflict to flag (not auto-resolve). Each anchor is exact text in the file named by `file`.

defects.related_global: Write concise commit messages, in the imperative mood.
defects.summary: The project commit-message rule merely restates the global one; drop the project copy (global keeps it in effect).
Project indentation rule contradicts the global one; flag as a conflict (project wins by precedence) rather than silently cutting either.

invariants.summary: Project-specific rule with no global equivalent; must survive.
